**Contact:** <name, email>

Steps and criteria come from Annex B (Technical), section 10. When the Annex changes, update this template.

## Before starting
- [ ] MoU signed
- [ ] Codebase declared (ncbo/ontoportal or ontoportal-lirmm fork), fork accessible to the Technical Team

## Phase 1: technical verification (weeks 1–2), Technical Team
- [ ] Virtual Appliance v3.1.1+ (v3.2.2 recommended)
- [ ] HTTPS with a valid public-CA certificate
- [ ] MOD-API endpoints operational
- [ ] Complete MOD metadata for 90%+ of artefacts (sample audit)
- [ ] Capacity for 95%+ availability; monitoring and alerts in place
- [ ] Federation accounts and API keys exchanged with the other portals

Checked by: @… on <date>

## Phase 2: participation scenario, Editorial Board
- [ ] Case A, B or C declared for each shared artefact; canonical portals agreed
- [ ] Migration plan reviewed

Checked by: @… on <date>

## Phase 3: compliance sign-off (weeks 5–6)
- [ ] MOD-API endpoints tested from the federated test environment
- [ ] Synchronisation test with the canonical portal (Case B)
- [ ] Technical team trained on MOD and MOD-API
- [ ] Portal added to the federation configuration of the other portals

Signed off by: @… on <date>
